explanation: OEIS A258667 (a ménage-problem variant with M seated 9 seats from his wife): the conjecture is a(n) ~ e^(−2) n!/(n−2) · (1 + Σ_{k≥1} (−1)^k/(k!(n−1)_k)). The formal a is the FORMULA-section expression (in the needed range the upper index of the second binomial is ≥ n − 5 > 0, so truncated subtraction is harmless), and it reproduces the DATA 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20, 116, 791, … (checked n ≤ 14). asymptoticTerm is exactly the conjectured expression with the finite falling-factorial sum, and the statement is IsEquivalent atTop. Faithful.
